item.statement: The machine learning potential used is optimized only for the liquid phase and is not guaranteed to be transferable to other parts of the phase space.
quotes: It is not guaranteed that this MTP is transferable to other parts of the DFT phase space.
The MTP involved in the proposed method is solely optimized for an accurate description of the part of the DFT phase space representative of the liquid.
The MTP functions only as a very efficient bridge to obtain DFT-accurate thermodynamics of the liquid phase.

item.statement: The current approach requires a multi-step fitting procedure involving low-converged DFT parameters first, followed by high-converged DFT calculations, to optimize efficiency.
quotes: We employed a two-stage fitting procedure to optimize efficiency. First, we fitted a low-quality MTP with level 20 (lowMTP) to liquid ab initio MD trajectories computed with low-converged DFT parameters...
Second, we fitted a high-quality MTP with level 24 (highMTP) using the DFT energies from the static DFT calculations in the preceding step.
